prompt:
Write a Verilog module named `fir13_v6_8b`, a 13-tap direct-form FIR filter with inputs `clk`, active-low `rst_n`, an 8-bit unsigned sample input `x`, and a 16-bit registered output `y`. Keep a 13-element delay line of past samples and each cycle output the low 16 bits of the sum of products of the taps with the fixed coefficients [19, 28, 42, 41, 60, 8, 17, 9, 28, 42, 19, 44, 37]. Clear state to 0 on `!rst_n`.

Use exactly this module interface (port names and widths must match):

module fir13_v6_8b (
    input  wire        clk,
    input  wire        rst_n,
    input  wire [7:0]  x,
    output reg  [15:0] y
);

Write standard synthesizable Verilog-2001. Active-low rst_n clears the outputs; outputs are registered on posedge clk.
